query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object('flags',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f.id,'flagger',coalesce(u.username::text,'Share link '||f.share_link_id::text),'at',f.created_at) ORDER BY f.created_at) FROM flags f LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=f.user_id WHERE f.photo_id=p.id AND f.resolved_at IS NULL))),'[]') AS "page!" FROM photos p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flags f WHERE f.photo_id=p.id AND f.resolved_at IS NULL)
